priorResults.status: blocked by the reference executor physical Escape stop before planned input

failureBudget: Attempt 1 failed. This continues attempt 2, the one corrective retry. A failed subcase ends A31-GLOW as fail; a blocked subcase keeps it pending. A self-check is harness preparation, not an attempt.

display.mismatch: blocks every live subcase in this run

target: New owned full-screen synthetic primary-monitor fixture; exact returned HWND and PID
setup: Activate the fixture through the source-owned window bridge before any marker starts; this is preparation, not a TRACE action

A31-GLOW-START.expected: Marker readiness for one monitor; fixture stays foreground with the same focused window before and after marker start

A31-GLOW-VISIBLE.expected: Desktop capture shows tinted left and top edge bands; the fixture verifies the interior is unchanged background

A31-GLOW-EOF.expected: Ordinary session close ends the marker process within 5 s; a later capture has no overlay and background edge bands

A31-GLOW-PARENT-LOSS.expected: Abrupt termination of the owning MCP server ends the marker within 5 s; no overlay remains; the desktop lease is free

A31-GLOW-REFERENCE-CLICK.expected: Count 0 -> 1 after exactly one reference-executor edge click through the glow

A31-GLOW-TRACE-CLICK.expected: Count 1 -> 2 after exactly one TRACE MCP edge click through the glow

classification: A TRACE MCP error or oracle mismatch fails the subcase; harness or environment errors block it with the recorded error
measurementRetries: A desktop capture may be repeated up to three times; captures dispatch no input
cleanup: Close owned sessions and servers, verify marker and server exit by PID, close the fixture through its command file and verify its exit
limits: Glow lifecycle owned by the Node MCP server in this build; alpha.3.2 moves it under the native supervisor
